Andhra Pradesh mandates audit of all C-section deliveries insured by state scheme

The government of Andhra Pradesh has mandated an audit of all C-section deliveries that are insured under the state's healthcare scheme. This decision was made in response to concerns about the high cost of these procedures. The audit will be conducted by a team appointed by the government, and it is expected to cover all eligible cases. The move aims to ensure transparency and accountability in the use of public funds for healthcare services. The audit process is expected to begin soon, with the first phase focusing on deliveries that took place between 2018 and 2020.
